falsifier: Reject the economic thesis if gross expectancy is non-positive or the baseline net expectancy is non-positive, and report fragility at the fixed 2x and 3x cost stresses. This retrospective study cannot establish pristine out-of-sample validity, verified broker PnL, or strategy approval.
hypothesis: After a prior 50-bar price expansion, one 30-minute bar of long trend continuation has positive expected price change on the Dukascopy USATECH.IDX/USD CFD proxy.
limitations: This derived view does not scan market data or independently rehash artifacts.
A terminal or cached attempt is not a valid trading approval.
Missing independent evidence, unknown tmux or failed jobs never imply PASS.
next_safe_action: Review failed or aborted attempts before selecting another registered trial.

plan.baseline: $100000 normalized cash with one long unit at most, no leverage, and no trades outside the frozen rule. A unit means $1 per index point for arithmetic only.

costs.assumptions: 3 bps adverse fill-price impact plus 0.6 bps explicit commission per fill. Scale both components at 1x, 2x and 3x. Spread and slippage are assumptions.

declared_trials.description: One fixed 2020-2024 Model 8 CFD price-proxy replay with the frozen prior-high 50 feature and native entry/exit rules; report 1x/2x/3x costs descriptively.

evaluation.daily_risk_metrics: Use the installed ml4t.diagnostic.api.PortfolioAnalysis on one return per scheduled UTC CFD trading date, including Sunday sessions; omit schedule- closed dates, retain zero-return open dates without trades, use periods_per_year=252, and disclose that this is a convention for the six-day schedule. Undefined metrics remain null. Independently reconcile Sharpe, maximum drawdown, and Calmar arithmetic.
evaluation.end_boundary: A signal at t is eligible only when its known t+2 30-minute clock is strictly earlier than 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z; eligibility must not inspect future source-bar presence.
evaluation.falsifier_rule: INCONCLUSIVE if no trades; FALSIFIED if native gross total PnL <= 0 or 1x native net trade expectancy <= 0; FRAGILE if positive at 1x but net trade expectancy <= 0 at 2x or 3x; otherwise NOT_FALSIFIED_IN_RETROSPECTIVE_SAMPLE_ONLY.
evaluation.strategy: Strict close[t] > max(high[t-50:t]); signal at completed bar t close; next-open entry t+1; next-next-open exit t+2; no stops or targets.

declared_instruments.session: Published summer/winter GMT schedule with conservative XNAS weekday holiday filter; unexpected missing scheduled fills block
declared_instruments.venue: Dukascopy Bank SA historical CFD price proxy
